minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, May 19, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 19, 2021 via Zoom.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst and Jenny Jolly.
  Members Absent: Lorraine Missick Scott Snider and Amanda Triay.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Service Manager
  Guests present: None.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, April 21,
  2021 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: 113 meals served per week to curbside recipients in April
  2021. Curbside meal service will continue until County approves congregated meals.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: There are seven to eight participants via Zoom. Computer setup and
  flashboard is reversing causing it not to work correctly, but usable. About $2,700 in
  the account. Live Bingo at the park being offered on Thursday, June 24th. Due to
  lack of staffing in person bingo at the Community Center may return at the end of
  July.

5. Meals on Wheels: 819 meals provided to La Verne residents. 22 per day, 43
  participants.

6. Account Balance: $3,860.53

7. Senior Program Fees: $50 earned from Visiting Angels outdoor crafting program.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: All virtual classes until fall.

9. Aging Next: For 2020, there were 198 inquires from La Verne residents.
  2021 inquiries: January had 16, February had 13, March had 13 and April had 10.
  In 2020 there were 1,046 Meals and so far in 2021 there have been 174 meals
  given.
   New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Monday, May 17th – American Red Cross Blood Drive 10:00 AM-4:00 PM
  Monday, May 17th – Military Council Meeting & Reception, 6:30 PM
  Wednesday, May 26th – Thanks a Latte, 10-11:30 AM
  Thursday, May 27th – Preschool Graduation at Veterans Hall, 9:00 AM- 1:00 PM

11. Facilities Report: The roof repair at the Community Center is completed but may still
  have a leak. Also, walls have been painted. Restrooms at Veterans Hall are
  completed and ADA complaint.

12. Public Comments: George gave a golf update that they are currently playing twice a
  month with 20 people participating each month.

  Yvonne announced the completion of the inclusion playground at Las Flores Park.
  This is the first inclusion playground in the City of La Verne. Next meeting will be
  held at Heritage Park where there will be a tour of the park after the meeting.

  Jenny asked if the tennis courts can be turned into pickle ball since she has received
  some inquiries.

13. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  The meeting was adjourned at 10:55 AM. Next meeting will be held at Heritage Park
  on Wednesday, June 16, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
